nodes.name: Creating Multimodal Interactive Agents with Imitation and Self-Supervised Learning
Imitation Learning
nodes.description: Learning from human demonstrations to instill intelligent behavioural priors in agents.

nodes.name: Self-Supervised Learning
nodes.description: Auxiliary training objective used in conjunction with imitation learning to improve performance.

nodes.name: Behavioural Cloning (BC)
nodes.description: Sequence learning technique used for imitation learning from trajectories of human behaviour.

nodes.name: Hierarchical Action Selection
nodes.description: Architectural technique that improves agent performance, implemented via a hierarchical movement policy.

nodes.name: Playhouse Dataset
nodes.description: Dataset collected in the Playhouse environment comprising 275,676 train episodes and 34,399 test episodes.

nodes.name: MIA (Multimodal Interactive Agent)
nodes.description: A multimodal interactive agent that interacts naturally with humans in a simulated world.

nodes.name: Playhouse
nodes.description: A 3D virtual multi-room environment based on the Unity game engine for studying natural interactions.

nodes.name: Language Games
nodes.description: A collection of prompted interaction-types and free-form instructions centering Playhouse interactions.

nodes.name: Agent Success Rate
nodes.description: MIA successfully interacts with non-adversarial humans 75% of the time.
